body:
With CuPy 8.6.0, 9.1.0, and master on Ubuntu 18.04 with Cuda 10.2 running the following code produces some kind of internal compiler error in cupy:
```
import cupy as cp
a = cp.zeros((66, 66, 66, 200, 32), 'f')
a[33, 33, 33, 80, 0] = 1.
```

The code that triggers this error was working several months ago, but I haven't found a working version to use yet.

I haven't pinned down exactly how big the array `a` needs to be to trigger this error yet, but does have to be large. Just setting the first item of a 2x2x2x2x2 array didn't hit the error. This example uses almost 8GB of VRAM.
